info.title: PingMessenger API

post.description: Create a device session using exactly one of username, email, or ping_id plus a password. Email login is allowed only after the email contact is OTP-verified; email is optional at signup.
Complete one enabled MFA factor before creating a login session.
Start passwordless email login.
Verify a passwordless login code and create a session.
Change a password; verified contacts require a step-up code.
Complete contact step-up for a password change.
Complete password recovery with a one-time code.
Start privacy-preserving password recovery by username, ping ID, email, or phone.
Rotate a refresh token.
Create an account. Username is optional and unique when supplied; signup returns device-bound tokens.

get.description: Upgrade to a WebSocket and send check_username JSON frames for availability results.

post.description: Check whether a username is available.

delete.description: Disable disappearing messages for a conversation.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's disappearing-message setting for a conversation.

put.description: Set or disable disappearing messages for a conversation.

get.description: Receive disappearing-message setting notifications for a conversation.

post.description: Create an idempotent payment ledger record for a conversation.

get.description: Upgrade to a participant-filtered WebSocket. Both from_user_id and to_user_id receive payment.updated events, including chain success, chain failure, and platform timeout failures; HTTP remains the recovery source of truth.

post.description: Discover registered contacts from supplied email addresses or phone numbers.

Search active users by partial username or exact verified email, phone, or PingID. Results use OpenIM-compatible identity fields; relationship is -1 because this global directory lookup does not evaluate the local friend graph.
Apply a signed PingPay-user transaction update to the platform ledger.
Issue an email or phone verification challenge. Requests are limited to one per minute and five per hour per contact and requester IP; throttled requests return 429 with Retry-After.
Add an email or phone contact after signup. The contact remains unverified until the returned challenge is completed; a verified contact cannot be changed.
Verify a non-login MFA challenge.
Register or rotate this device's P-256 public key. Private keys remain on the device.
Create a session-bound device-proof challenge.
Verify the signed device proof and issue an OpenIM token for this device.

get.description: Get one payment visible to the authenticated participant.
Get the normalized transaction and native/token transfers extracted from the chain RPC. The response is unavailable until indexing succeeds.
Get the authenticated user's profile asset URL.

post.description: Update a non-unique nickname and/or upload an image as multipart/form-data (JPEG, PNG, or WebP; max 5 MiB).

patch.description: Set or change the optional unique username.

post.description: Replace backup codes after a step-up challenge.
Enroll an email, phone, or TOTP factor.
Disable an enabled MFA factor.
Confirm TOTP enrollment.
Revoke selected sessions or all other sessions.

get.description: List global timer values for authenticated clients; timers are operator-controlled.

post.description: Upload an image or video story (maximum 10 MiB per upload, 10 active stories, and 40 retained rows per user). Expiry defaults to 24 hours.

get.description: Upgrade to the authenticated, default-subscribed story WebSocket. Live create/delete events are pushed to eligible network users; send a sync or get query for replay and acknowledge durable cursors.

delete.description: Delete one of the authenticated user's stories.

post.description: Record a view and optional reaction.

get.description: List views and reactions for the authenticated owner's story.
